full_prompt_en: A square photomontage builds a woman's face from misaligned black-and-white photographic fragments. The upper half is dominated by a pale forehead and two large eyes cut from separate rectangular pieces; their seams do not quite meet. A narrow dark vertical slice interrupts the nose and cheek, while a pale hand rests beneath the mouth and chin across the lower middle. Behind and around the assembled face, old printed pages, small historical photographs, diagrams, and circles crowd the frame. Sepia, charcoal, faded olive, and dull orange paper scraps create a dense background, with a few clean black areas sharpening the central cutout. Some pieces retain visible straight edges, torn corners, and irregular overlaps, making the construction tactile and openly artificial. The face has a sober, searching expression, heightened by the mismatched scale of the eyes and interrupted features. Light comes from the original photographic fragments: pale frontal values on skin, deep printed shadows around the eyes, and no single natural light source across the collage. Smaller textures and archive images recede behind the large face but remain readable as a busy paper field. The composition is frontal and densely layered, with abrupt shifts of size and tone. It feels analytical, mysterious, and dislocated, as if several histories have been pressed into one image.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形照相蒙太奇以错位黑白照片碎片拼出一张女子面孔。上半部由苍白额头和从不同长方形片中剪出的两只大眼占据，接缝不能完全吻合。窄深色竖片切断鼻与面颊，一只浅色手在画面下中部托住口与下巴。拼合面孔的周围与后方挤满旧印刷页、小历史照片、图解与圆形。深褐、炭色、褪色橄榄与暗橙纸片构成浓密背景，几处纯黑使中央剪影更清楚。部分碎片保留可见直边、撕裂角和不规则覆盖，让拼装具有可触且坦露的人造感。脸带严肃寻找的神情，双眼尺度不一、特征断裂又加深这一感受。光来自各张原始照片：皮肤正面值浅，眼周印刷暗影深，拼贴全幅并无单一自然光源。较小纹理与档案图像后退在大脸之后，却仍作为繁忙纸面可辨。构图正面且层次浓密，尺度和明暗突然切换。它有分析、神秘与错位之感，仿佛多段历史被压入一张图。
style_prompt_en: Dada-like photomontage combines stark black-and-white cutouts with aged sepia, olive, and burnt-orange print. Hard rectangular seams and torn overlaps remain visible. Abrupt shifts of scale, tone, and photographic grain make the image deliberately discontinuous. Large pale focal shapes are embedded in a dense field of smaller archive textures and diagrams. Light is inherited from separate fragments, creating clashing directions and deep printed blacks rather than continuous modeled illumination. The composition is layered, frontal, and intellectually restless, with paper edges and mechanical reproduction central to its tactile character.
style_prompt_zh: 达达式照相蒙太奇把高反差黑白剪片与旧深褐、橄榄和焦橙印刷物结合。硬朗长方接缝与撕裂重叠边保留可见。尺度、明暗和照片颗粒突变，使画面有意不连续。大块浅色焦点嵌在较小档案肌理与图解的浓密底层中。光线继承自不同碎片，形成互相冲突的方向和深印刷黑，而非连贯塑形照明。构图层叠、正面而思绪不宁，纸边与机械复制是其可触特征的核心。
theme_en: A woman's face assembled from archival photographs and print scraps
theme_zh: 由旧照片与印刷碎片拼成的女子面孔
name: Hannah Hoch
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
